magnet.name: Shard-Lure Tendrils
magnet.description: Filamented feelers thrum with occult magnetism, drawing extra shards from every shattered brick your creature claims.

soulMagnet.name: Soul Magnet
soulMagnet.description: A soul-attuned gland tugs loose remnants from fallen foes, increasing the chance to extract souls after a kill.

perforator.name: Rending Tentacles
perforator.description: Whip-like limbs tear through targets so the force bleeds into adjacent masonry, weakening the formation around the strike.

vitalHull.name: Vital Flesh
vitalHull.description: Bio-reactive tissues graft and swell, thickening the creature’s living bulk and knitting wounds as it grows.

ironForge.name: Iron Fangs
ironForge.description: Hardened iron fangs and knuckle-spikes bite deeper, turning each swing into a brutal, mauling strike.

silverArmor.name: Silver Carapace
silverArmor.description: Interlocking argent scutes sheathe the body, scattering incoming blows across mirrored scales.

internalFurnace.name: Coal Heart
internalFurnace.description: An embered heart pumps heat through sinew—each consecutive hit stokes the blaze, compounding your offensive frenzy.

mendingGland.name: Mending Pheromone Gland
mendingGland.description: Cultured sacs seep soothing pheromones that ripple through the pack, stitching flesh back together. Healing amount = (unit's attack) × (module multiplier). Limited to 10 heals per unit per run.

frenzyGland.name: Frenzy Pheromone Gland
frenzyGland.description: Pressurized nodules burst with acrid signals, goading nearby allies into a sharp, short-lived killing trance. Bonus damage per attack = (unit's attack) × (module multiplier).

fireballOrgan.name: Fireball Organ
fireballOrgan.description: A blazing core pulses with infernal energy, launching searing fireballs every 4 seconds. Each fireball explodes on impact, dealing (0.75 + 0.0375×level) × unit damage to the target brick and all neighbors within 40 units. However, each fireball launch causes 250% of the fireball's damage as self-damage to the unit.

burningTail.name: Melting Tail
burningTail.description: Caustic glands coat struck masonry, making it more vulnerable to subsequent hits for a short time.

freezingTail.name: Freezing Tail
freezingTail.description: Thread cryogenic veins through the tail, letting each blow sheath bricks in biting frost.

tailNeedles.name: Chord Needles
tailNeedles.description: Socket barbed quills into the chord’s tip so every strike unleashes sideways volleys of piercing shards.

conductorTentacles.name: Conductor Tentacles
conductorTentacles.description: Copper-filamented feelers discharge volatile surges that leap between nearby masonry and foes.
